trickyParts: A lost pod's binding lingers on the server for minutes; a holder that subscribed beside it records stale_binding so the next holder, taking a released record, does not mistake it for a pre-INFRA-557 build.

The settle hold ends when every ack-pending message of the consumer is in this pod's hands, so a SIGKILL with nothing in hand delivers after the lease TTL (~5-6 s) and a node loss once the dead pod's messages return (~11-12 s); a NAK-delayed retry outstanding keeps the hold to its 13 s cap.
